none: PAS CAM-F85E11: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian, AD 364-378
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian, AD 364-378 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads [SECVRITAS - REI PVBLICAE]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm. Mint is uncertain. Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse shows diamdemed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: OF/[...]//[...]. Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight is 2.28g, diameter…
